programme.title: A Royal Christmas Hope (2025)
programme.desc: At Christmastime in New York City, Julia Carter runs a nonprofit helping families in need. Still grieving her husband, she fights to keep hope alive—especially through her non-profit work and the annual tree lighting. Across the ocean, Prince Christopher escapes royal duties for a break in the U.S. When a chance meeting sparks connection, their bond deepens, and secrets and holiday pressures force them to face what truly matters.

programme.title: A Christmas Post (2024)
programme.desc: Noah Harrington is hired to revitalize a reluctant small town. When he finds undelivered Santa letters from the 1990s, he teams up with local historian Tessa Findlay to track down the long-lost gifts and bring early Christmas joy. As sparks fly between them, Noah hides one letter—Tessa’s childhood wish to ring the town’s Christmas bell before the post office is demolished. Can he save the bell, his job, and their budding romance in time?

programme.title: A Christmas Vintage (2023)
programme.desc: Samantha goes home to her family winery for the holidays after discovering that her family is in trouble. Her sister is doomed for heartbreak and her father refuses to produce new red blends after the loss of her mother, the winemaker, which will cost them the winery. She will have to believe her inner talent of winemaking while trying to woo and date the unpleasant owner of a competing winery, Parker Williams.

programme.title: A Perfect Christmas Pairing (2023)
programme.desc: Winter sets in as top chef Grace Cooke, at the helm of a high-end restaurant, rakes in rave reviews due to her gastro-scientific approach to cuisine. She’s close to a Michelin star when a bad review from a top critic rocks her world. With her boss’ blessing, she takes time off to see her family at their winery B&B over Christmas. There, she connects with worldly travel writer Asher St. James, and sparks fly with family traditions as Asher helps her reconnect with her roots.

programme.title: Christmas Together (2023)
programme.desc: After Ava’s workaholic boyfriend cancels their vacation over the holidays, she leave New York City for California for some time to think. She meets Mia online through a home rental site (not knowing she is only 12 years old), who convinces her widowed Dad Mason to rent out the guest home during the holidays. After arriving in California, Ava realizes the situation and offers to pack up and leave, but both they convince her to stay and enjoy the holidays together.

programme.title: The Tree That Saved Christmas (2023)
programme.desc: Struggling writer Annie Logan is devasted to learn that she won't be able to go home to the family tree farm in time for Christmas due to the demands of her high-powered boss. But when the tree farm is threatened with closure, Annie bids her life in New York goodbye and rushes home to save the place she has always called home.

programme.title: A Cherry Pie Christmas (2025)
programme.desc: A talented pastry chef returns to her hometown in Door County, WI, for the holidays, only to find herself torn between pursuing her dream job in the city or preserving her family’s cherished cherry orchard. With the orchard’s future uncertain, a lost cherry pie recipe, and the unexpected reappearance of her high school sweetheart, she must rediscover what truly matters—and decide if love and tradition can guide her future.

programme.title: A Christmas Murder Mystery (2025)
programme.desc: Every Christmas, the wealthy Sterlings gather at their remote estate to keep tradition alive. But when patriarch Harold Sterling is found poisoned after hinting at a shocking change to his will, buried secrets erupt. With the sheriff away, puzzle editor Vera Vexley and Deputy Neal race against time to unmask the killer among ambitious heirs, a loyal lawyer, and mysterious guests—before greed, lies, and betrayal claim another life.

programme.title: Christmas Town (2026)
programme.desc: Disillusioned workaholic Liza McCann and her son ravel to Christmas Town to visit her father, whom she hasn't seen in years. The city's profuse decorations and intense Yuletide spirit conspire to sweep her up in a series of inexplicable events, and now Liza is forced to rethink everything she thought was true.

programme.title: A Christmas to Remember (2026)
programme.desc: As Christmas dinner preparations unravel, Lauren welcomes friends Megan, Paige, and lonely coworker Nora into her home. Through heartfelt stories of life-changing Christmases, they rediscover the power of kindness, authenticity, forgiveness, and chosen family. As her husband Tom finally arrives and dinner is served, Lauren realizes that the greatest holiday gifts aren't found under the tree, but in love, friendship, and second chances.

programme.title: Last Chance for Christmas (2015)
programme.desc: When Prancer injures his hoof Santa’s stable hand, John, must find a fill in to ensure Christmas deliveries go off without a hitch. His mission gets complicated when he discovers that Frankie, the perfect substitute reindeer, belongs to a precocious 8-year-old girl and her mother Annie. As he races to get Frankie up to the North Pole, he realizes that he’s actually falling in love with Annie and has to find a way to win her over and save Christmas at the same time.

programme.title: Christmas Lover's Anonymous (2021)

Katrina joins �Christmas Lovers Anonymous� to indulge her Christmas spirit and meets a special guy. To her surprise, her online friend and Hunter share more in common than she realizes.

programme.desc: After leaving her Amish community in her youth, a New York book editor finds herself in desperate need of a new cookbook to save her job. With Christmas on the horizon Sarah heads back to her family farm to reconnect. But with the presence of a handsome local�an outsider, but one that is friendly with the Amish community�he and Sarah sense chemistry and work together to save her family�s Amish bakery (developing an Amish Christmas Cookbook in the process).

programme.title: A Christmas Wish in Hudson (2021)
programme.desc: Christmas is special for Lori, but she�s overworked and underappreciated. When her boss demands she work over the holidays, she quits.
